recommendation_en: When mother’s own milk is not available, donor human milk may be considered for feeding of preterm or low-birth-weight (LBW) infants, including very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very LBW (< 1.5 kg) infants. (Conditional recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendation_zh: 当母亲自身的母乳不可用时，可以考虑使用捐赠人乳喂养早产或低出生体重（LBW）婴儿，包括极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低体重（< 1.5 kg）婴儿。（条件推荐，中等确定性证据）
